boarding_points.name: Puerto Aventuras Marina
boarding_points.notes: The closest working marina between Tulum and Playa del Carmen; the practical sea gateway to the Tulum area and hub for the luxury charter market.

note: Experiences/charter basis. No scheduled regulated pax series → null hard economics until a series is pinned. Tulum's beach lacks a formal harbour; Puerto Aventuras is the sealed marine endpoint.
